module.purpose: Defines versioned NestJS request DTOs and validation rules for creating standard, instant, and recurring bookings.
module.summary: This module models booking creation payloads, including attendees, event identification, locations, metadata, routing, guest information, and optional booking duration. Decorators provide OpenAPI schemas, runtime transformation, primitive validation, nested validation, custom contact validation, event identification requirements, location validation, and metadata constraints. Specialized inputs extend the shared booking payload for instant and recurring booking workflows.
module.businessContext: This file validates inbound booking API requests before scheduling meetings and assigning ownership. Failures can reject legitimate bookings or allow malformed booking, attendee, routing, or metadata data into downstream systems.
classes: CreateBookingAttendee (~L74-122): Represents attendee identity, contact methods, timezone, and preferred language.
Routing (~L124-177): Carries routing-form assignment and CRM ownership information.
CreateBookingInput_2024_08_13 (~L191-341): Defines the versioned payload for creating a booking.
CreateInstantBookingInput_2024_08_13 (~L343-351): Extends booking creation with instant-booking status.
CreateRecurringBookingInput_2024_08_13 (~L353-364): Extends booking creation with recurrence count.
functions: RequireEventTypeIdentification (~L26-48): Registers validation requiring a usable event type identifier.
RequireEmailOrPhone (~L50-71): Registers validation requiring attendee contact information.
systemCapabilities: Validate routing and CRM assignment data

edgeCases.inputShape: Attendee with neither email nor phoneNumber
edgeCases.behavior: Custom validation rejects the attendee with an at-least-one-contact-method message.

edgeCases.inputShape: Booking without eventTypeId and without a complete slug-based identifier
edgeCases.behavior: Custom validation rejects the booking with FAILED_EVENT_TYPE_IDENTIFICATION_ERROR_MESSAGE.

edgeCases.inputShape: Invalid email or non-international phone number
edgeCases.behavior: Field validation reports the configured invalid email or phone format message.
The location type permits a string for backwards compatibility while applying location validation.

edgeCases.inputShape: Missing or non-positive lengthInMinutes or recurrenceCount
edgeCases.behavior: Optional values are accepted when absent and must be integers with minimum value one when present.

invariants.description: An attendee must provide at least one of phoneNumber or email.
A booking must provide eventTypeId, or eventTypeSlug with username or teamSlug.
The booking start value must be an ISO date string.
Booking duration and recurrence count, when supplied, must be positive integers.
Nested attendee and routing objects are transformed and validated as their declared classes.

assumptions.description: A NestJS validation pipeline invokes the class-validator decorators against instantiated DTO objects.
Imported location and metadata validators define the detailed constraints for those fields.
Nested attendee and routing payloads are transformed through class-transformer before nested validation.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking identifies its event type with eventTypeId.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the primary event type identification path.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking omits eventTypeId but supplies eventTypeSlug and username.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the documented alternative user-owned event type lookup.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An attendee provides neither an email nor a phone number.
moduleContractTests.then: validation fails with "Attendee must have at least one contact method (email or phone number)"

moduleContractTests.scenario: Metadata exceeds the permitted key or value limits.
moduleContractTests.then: validation fails with "Metadata must have at most 50 keys, each key up to 40 characters, and string values up to 500 characters."
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves the metadata schema limits exposed by the DTO.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A recurring booking supplies a recurrence count below one.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the minimum recurrence count constraint.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A booking supplies a length in minutes below one.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the minimum selectable booking duration.
